messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: DIR, Annex I, 4.2.2

4.2.2. Loading control Machinery with a maximum working load of not less than 1 000 kilograms or an overturning moment of not less than 40 000 Nm must be fitted with devices to warn the driver and prevent dangerous movements in the event: — of overloading, either as a result of the maximum working load or the maximum working moment due to the load being exceeded, or — of the overturning moment being exceeded.

response.text:
Machinery | mustBeFittedWith | devices to warn the driver and prevent dangerous movements | maximum working load of not less than 1 000 kilograms or overturning moment of not less than 40 000 Nm | Machinery with a maximum working load of not less than 1 000 kilograms or an overturning moment of not less than 40 000 Nm must be fitted with devices to warn the driver and prevent dangerous movements
Loading control devices | mustWarnAndPreventDangerousMovements | overloading | overloading results from the maximum working load or maximum working moment being exceeded due to the load | of overloading, either as a result of the maximum working load or the maximum working moment due to the load being exceeded
Loading control devices | mustWarnAndPreventDangerousMovements | exceeding of the overturning moment | the overturning moment being exceeded | of the overturning moment being exceeded
